newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says Airbus proposed cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says Airbus proposed cooperation.

text.p: Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan said on Wednesday the chairman of Airbus had proposed manufacturing cooperation with Turkey on a visit to the country.

"Yesterday the chairman of Europe's biggest aircraft company Airbus came to Turkey and brought a proposal of cooperation in manufacturing," Erbakan told reporters ahead of a meeting with economy officials.
"This has great meaning...because Turkey has become an attractive centre for global financial institutions and the country is seeing much interest from investors," he said.
He did not provide any more details.
